status: DECLARED before the governing run (tools/run_daily_totals.py --score). The configuration was chosen in the exploration disclosed below, on the same four development months; the governing run therefore confirms arithmetic. The evidence that does not come from those months is the twelve-month check: eight other months of 2025 with another predictor, read with this configuration after it had been chosen.

user_decision.context: after being told that EUROCONTROL's daily all-cause pre-departure delay is a daily total of the off-block times the ranking file hides, stronger than the monthly source behind v47, that a reviewer would more readily call it leakage, and that the recommendation was to build the method on 2025 only and decide on shipping once it passes a declared rule. Earlier the same day, on the portal's monthly aggregates: 'yes use it'. Nothing is uploaded without a further word.

external_data.name: EUROCONTROL Performance Review Unit, All-causes pre-departure delay (airport, day)
external_data.columns_used: FLT_DATE, APT_ICAO, FLT_DEP_IFR_2 (departures behind the figure), DLY_ALL_PRE_2 (minutes of pre-departure delay, all causes; airport operator data)
external_data.terms: published by EUROCONTROL for information purposes; may be copied in whole or in part provided EUROCONTROL is mentioned as the source and it is not used for commercial purposes; no modification without prior written permission. Not an open licence.
external_data.organiser_statement: asked about published aggregates of the ranking period, 'I already answered above: yes'. No ruling names this workbook.
external_data.nature: per airport and off-block day, the sum over departures of max(off-block - schedule, 0): in 2025 it equals that sum from the supplied clocks within 0.0-0.3 s per flight at seven airports in every month (EHAM -1 to -7 s, LFPG +2 to +5 s, LSZH 0 to -3 s). It is an aggregate of the hidden clock of the ranking rows. No official score and no leaderboard information is used.

procedure.code: src/prc2026_daily/reconcile.py (row model, day model, posterior), tools/run_daily_totals.py (cells, scales, months)
procedure.summary: per airport and off-block day (takeoff minus prediction gives the day), the published total against the total the predictions imply; rows are independent given a day shift of the ordinary labels; every row that is not heavy moves by the posterior mean of the day shift plus a first-order tilt; heavy rows (sd of their positive-delay error above 900 s: fill candidates, one-day candidates) enter the day's arithmetic and keep their prediction
procedure.fitting_side: cells (recorded outcomes of comparable rows), the published figure's accuracy per airport (robust sd, share of days off by more than ten minutes, at least 0.02) and the day-shift scale tau per airport (airport-day means of residuals within 600 s, days of at least 100 rows, sampling variance removed, at least 5 s) come from the months other than the one read
procedure.airport_day_read: when the rows cover at least 90% of the departures behind the published figure; other rows keep their prediction
procedure.free_parameters: none fitted on scores or on the scored months

development_read.control: the v46 development stack on runs/lomo_dev/rows.parquet (tools/run_share_gate_reread.full_stack at network share 0.85 with the nd1200 gate)
development_read.construction: for each month, the fitting side from the other three months
development_read.rule: accepted when no equal-footing month is worse on all rows, the mean change over them is at least 0.02% below zero and every equal-footing month's paired-day 95% interval (by off-block day, seed 20260929) lies below zero. November is reported.
